payload.claim: Criterion 1's and criterion 2's claims each pack an unusually large number of sub-behaviors (criterion 1: roughly fifteen distinct shape, ordering and refusal behaviors; criterion 2: a precisely-specified eleven-member, two-set, seven-flagged fixture) behind a single witness. This matches the repo's own precedent for `wrong_versions` and the spec explicitly tells the implementer to copy that shape, so it is not a defect, but the main execution risk is getting every sub-clause actually asserted, not merely exercised, in one test body.
